Miura Daichi appears on tiny desk concerts JAPAN
Known for his remarkable vocal ability and expressive performance style, Miura Daichi makes his debut in the intimate "tiny desk" space inside the NHK office. For this special session, he is joined by an 18-member gospel choir in a rare and powerful ensemble.
In the limited space of tiny desk, the choir's overwhelming harmonies blend with Miura's fluid, soaring vocals, creating a one-of-a-kind performance that embodies the pure power of song.
The uplifting energy of gospel and the subtle, breath-like nuances of Miura's singing come together to form a luxurious musical experience unique to tiny desk concerts JAPAN. At this extraordinary close distance, viewers will encounter Miura Daichi in a way they have never seen?or heard?before.
